# discord_guild_emoji (Resource)

Manages a custom Discord guild emoji. Requires `CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS` / `MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS`. Note: Discord documents that emoji routes do not follow normal rate-limit conventions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_guild_emoji" "blobwave" {
  guild_id = "123456789012345678"
  name     = "blobwave"
  # Image must be a data URI. filebase64 + a data: prefix is one way to supply it.
  image = "data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/blobwave.png")}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild. Changing this forces a new emoji.
- `image` (String) Emoji image as a data URI (`data:image/png;base64,...`). Discord does not return the image on read, so it is write-only; changing it forces a new emoji.
- `name` (String) Emoji name (2-32 characters, alphanumerics and underscores).

### Optional

- `roles` (Set of String) Snowflake IDs of roles allowed to use this emoji (empty means everyone).

### Read-Only

- `animated` (Boolean) Whether the emoji is animated.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Emojis are imported using "guild_id:emoji_id". The image is not recoverable.
terraform import discord_guild_emoji.blobwave 123456789012345678:987654321098765432
```
